newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down five cents to 14.70 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down five cents to 14.70 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell five cents to 14.70 ringgit ($5.86) a kg on heavy selling, despite a higher London Metal Exchange (LME) close on Friday.
"There were plenty of buyers this morning and the buyers only came in at lower levels," said a dealer.

Offers totalled 115 tonnes against bids of 88. Final turnover was at 95 tonnes, compared to 94 on Friday. Buyers were from Europe and Malaysia. The local premium over LME fell to $30 a tonne from $65 previously. The market's near term trend was dependent on speculation in copper on the LME, said dealers.
